type: ProfileEvidenceError extends Error; fixed generic message+one code only
strictErrors: shape/identity/duplicate/order/schema/digest/secret/capacity failures refuse new projection or sidecar; no raw input values/cause echo
validPartial: returned failed/aborted/harness-error/not-run/not-implemented/cleanup-unknown evidence is structurally retainable with truthful state; never all-pass or qualification
IOAggregation: existing writer propagates original execution/cleanup failure plus new persistence failure once; do not replace primary exception or print caller data
readiness: every output always claimEligiblefalse+qualificationReadyfalse. Keep explicit missing owner/setup/applicability/prerequisites, partial clause and external unresolved conditions; never certify N/A or capability.
